{{Quote|&hellip;and this is the planet's tropical zone.''"<br />"''It's not Tatooine, that's for sure.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker, navigating a snowstorm|audio=NotTatooine.flac|<ref name="Trespass" />}}
'''Orto Plutonia''' was a desolate [[Water/Legends|icy]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Pantora system/Legends|Pantora system]], home to the native [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] and a number of [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatches]]. It was considered a [[Protectorate (government system)/Legends|protectorate]] of the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]] until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when the Talz inhabitants were granted political supremacy by the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] following a brief [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|conflict]] with
[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.

==History==
Orto Plutonia had long been a [[Protectorate (government system)/Legends|protectorate]] of the nearby [[Pantora/Legends|Pantoran]] moon, after [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] scouts searched the world and declared it uninhabited. They had missed the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] population, which lived in the ice canyons in villages carved out of the ice walls, filled with huts made from animal skins pulled over bone-frames. The Talz lived a simple existence, somehow subsisting off the harsh environment, and using the native [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]] cats as mounts and protection. It is unknown how or why that Talz clan colonized the planet; Talz of Orto Plutonia were more aggressive and war-like than other members of their [[Species/Legends|species]] who belonged to the galactic community.

At the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the demands for forbidden [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]]-pets from Orto Plutiona was higher than ever.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|Banned Beasts}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] requested that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] establish an outpost on Orto Plutonia to serve as an advanced warning station for any [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] incursions. To that end, the Republic established [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]], a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] outpost built within a massive ice spire. The Separatists too established a temporary base in the ice, and all this activity aggravated the Talz. When the Separatists discovered the Talz, they attacked them, but the Talz fought back. Glid Station got caught in the middle of the conflict, which ended in the Talz slaughter of all Separatists and Republic personnel on the planet. The Talz also left behind grim warnings against future trespassers - droid heads and clone helmets left perched atop spears.

[[File:TalzCavalry-Trespass.png|thumb|left|250px|Orto Plutonia's native Talz and their narglatch mounts.]]

The Republic sent a task force to investigate, led by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], assisted by a squad of [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault troopers]]. The [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] side was represented by the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], whom the chairman brought along to have some measure of authority over the Jedi. Cho believed that the Separatists had attacked [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]], but the Jedi investigated the disappearance of their troopers and discovered the [[Talz village/Legends|Talz village]]. They were welcomed as visitors to the [[Chieftain's hut (Talz village)/Legends|chieftain's hut]], and Talz leader [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]] explained that the Talz simply wanted to be left alone on their world. Kenobi and Skywalker promised a peaceful negotiation with the Pantorans, but the chairman did not want to lose claim over Orto Plutonia. When it became an apparent that Orto Plutonia had a native population, Cho at first refused to believe it, and then later declared [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|war]] to wipe out the Talz and keep the planet under Pantoran control.

Before the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]] was able to intervene, Cho led a charge of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] against the Talz, which went poorly and the Talz nearly overwhelmed Cho's forces, fatally wounding Cho in the process. Cho's violent gambit failed, and when he told reinforcements under Senator Chuchi to continue the war, he died in disbelief that the Assembly called his decision out of order. Senator Chuchi, backed by the [[Pantoran Assembly/Legends|Pantoran Assembly]], ceded ownership of Orto Plutonia to the Talz, allowing them sovereignty over the planet. She withdrew the Republic and [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] presence from the world, leaving the Talz free to live their quiet life in their ice canyon villages.

Years later, about [[1 BBY/Legends|one year before]] the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] traveled across the inhospitable surface of Orto Plutonia on a particularly difficult job.<ref name="SWIANH">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Illustrated: A New Hope|cardname=One Year Earlier - Boba Fett}}</ref>
